Registration for Library ID

Submit the form below to request activation of your library account and circulation privileges.

Registration Form

Document upload can be completed at the circulation desk after form submission.

Process Checklist

  1. Fill all required details in the registration form.
  2. Submit form and note the generated request number.
  3. Visit library desk with original ID proof.
  4. Collect library card after verification.

Processing time is usually 1 to 2 working days based on verification queue.
